newsitem.title: USA: Most IMM currency futures end with slight losses.
newsitem.headline: Most IMM currency futures end with slight losses.

text.p: June 18 - Most IMM currencies ended with slight losses. Sept yen and marks set fresh lows late. U.S. international trade data on Thursday are expected to show an increase in U.S.'s deficit. April deficit is seen at $10 bln, vs $8.51 bln in March. Waigel said he was confident of a German budget deal. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
